verdict.rationale: Natural-language control is a fair question for an operating system, but the evidence pack never shows Windows itself taking natural-language commands to operate the OS. The closest items do not qualify: Copilot is described only inside separate Microsoft apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Windows AI APIs are developer building blocks, Paint Cocreator generates art, and PowerShell is a scripting CLI rather than a natural-language interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
